title: EVENTOS UTMB® WORLD SERIES — series structure page
publisher: UTMB World Series / Torrencial Chile by UTMB
claims: The UTMB World Series are organised in three levels: UTMB World Series Finals, UTMB World Series Majors and UTMB World Series Events.
UTMB World Series Events are described as the best trail races on the planet and give the top three elite runners automatic entry to the Finals while all finishers collect Running Stones.
UTMB World Series Majors award double Running Stones and 225 automatic finals qualifications per Major.
Running Stones are required for the Dacia UTMB Mont-Blanc lottery, and UTMB Index races do not grant Running Stones.
